description: Google's JavaScript engine, shared by Chrome and Node.js. Compiles and runs your code and manages the heap.
C library under Node that provides the event loop, a thread pool and cross-platform access to files, sockets, timers and DNS.
I/O is handed to the OS or the thread pool; the JavaScript thread keeps running and a callback is queued when the result is ready.
I/O-bound work mostly waits (network, disk) and scales well on Node. CPU-bound work keeps the thread busy and blocks every other request.
Long Term Support: even-numbered majors (22, 24) get about 30 months of fixes. Production runs an LTS line.
Alternative JavaScript runtimes. Deno adds permissions and built-in tooling; Bun focuses on speed with JavaScriptCore. Both aim for Node compatibility.
